reviewCharts.warning: New Jersey review rows are county-level President-versus-U.S.-Senate comparisons from official statewide DOE PDFs. They are useful public-interest source-review inputs, but they are not municipal or precinct scatter plots. Municipal DOE PDFs, municipal geometry/crosswalks, and non-geographic Federal Overseas or Hand Counts handling remain follow-up work.

turnout.notes: New Jersey turnout rows use the official DOE 2024 General Election voter-turnout PDF. The retained reconciliation summary documents that DOE and EAC both report 4,321,921 ballots cast, while DOE reports 52,335 more registered voters than EAC fallback.

historicalBaselines.warning: New Jersey historical baseline rows are official DOE county-level 2020 presidential context with county:<GEOID> jurisdiction tags. Use them as contextual baseline rows only, not as 2024 certified data; 2012 and 2016 remain follow-up years.
